name: /caption command — ready-to-paste TikTok caption generator
goal: Add /caption <video_id> Telegram command. Owner sends /caption scs001-abc123, bot replies with a ready-to-copy TikTok caption: hook headline (from run script JSON if exists, fallback to topic from ledger) + newline + viral hashtags from viral-topics.json. Also add /caption (no args) shortcut to show caption for the top unposted video (same file-path logic as /post-now). Eliminates the last manual step in posting UX — operator no longer needs to write captions.
rationale: 0/30 posts, ~22 days to Apr 7. Manual posting toolkit is complete (nudges + /post-now + /record). Last friction point: operator must write a TikTok caption manually. /caption gives them a copy-paste ready string in under 1 second.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits (commands.ts + index.ts) + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — handleCaption()
tasks.description: handleCaption(chatId, ownerChatId, videoId?: string): owner-only gate. If videoId not provided: find first unposted entry in publish-ledger.jsonl that has captioned mp4 on disk (same runIdToEpoch logic as handlePostNow — already in commands.ts). If videoId provided: find that entry in ledger. Then: 1) load topic + speaker from ledger entry. 2) try to read run script JSON at workspace/scs001/run-{epoch}/script/{video_id}-script.json — look for .hook or .title field for hook text. 3) If script not found: use topic as hook text. 4) Load hashtags from viral-topics.json (top 4 topics prefixed with #) + #fyp #viral #learnontiktok. 5) Format caption: '{hook}\n\n{hashtags}'. 6) Send two Telegram messages: first a labeled header ('📋 TikTok caption for {video_id}:'), then the raw caption text in a code block (triple backtick) so operator can tap-to-copy on mobile. Also add '/caption — Generate ready-to-paste TikTok caption (owner)' to handleHelp.

tasks.title: index.ts — import handleCaption + route /caption
tasks.description: Add handleCaption to import from commands. Add case '/caption' in dispatch switch — extract optional video_id from message parts[1] (undefined if not provided).

tasks.description: 1) commands.ts exports handleCaption. 2) handleCaption reads viral-topics.json for hashtags. 3) handleCaption reads publish-ledger.jsonl. 4) handleHelp contains /caption. 5) index.ts routes /caption.
